season: Arena Season 5 (live) · Rumble Arena Season 1 ends 2026-10-08; Season 2 to 2026-10-21
lede: What Korean and global players run in regular Arena (아레나) and Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나). Every claim links to its post.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-10-07, the eve of the 10-08 update (Lv.120 cap, Chardonnay, Rumble Season 2). Re-check after it.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.
formation_slots: Slots read row<R>-<C> on the owner's formation screen: row 1 on top, column 1 back to column 6 front.

you.summary: Run built Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in both modes; keep Rye Rockstar for sub-7★ Bari; re-check after 10-08.
changes: Get Bari to 7–8★ for regular Arena; under that, the Rye deck usually wins.
Bari gear: no Skill Haste. Skill AMP + crit rate up top, DR + crit RES below.
Rye gear: three Skill Haste lines, top-right only; DR + crit RES bottom-right.
Rye deck flex: Rockstar. Skating Queen beside it.
Captain Milk, merc Lv.4, Armor Repair + Passion Pay; Milk ATK #1.
Rumble: consider Icy Birdie for Hot Doggie; half the top 10 run it.
Keep an accuracy preset for evasion defenders.
Attack late before the 00:00 settlement: defenses lose to equal attackers.
Level to 120 after 10-08: level counts in Arena.
Re-check the Rumble team when Season 2's buff shows: it may drop the Charge buff.

arena.lede: Regular, per-server Arena. Built Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola leads; the Rye deck is the value pick and the most-run lineup.
arena.caveat: crumb.gg's meta page is the only ladder data; its sample is unstated. Many 'Arena' screenshots are Rumble.

rules.title: Format
rules.body: Auto-battle: your attack team against another player's saved defense. No bans, picks or rounds.

rules.title: Teams
rules.body: Attack and defense are set separately. Refreshing the opponent list can cost crystals.

rules.title: Auto-repeat
rules.body: Continuous challenge (auto-repeat attacks) since 2026-09-10.

rules.title: Team size
rules.body: 12 cookies, 3 pets, a captain and two merc perks per side.

rules.title: Battle length
rules.body: About 60 s. Near the end '종료 임박' appears and damage rises.

rules.title: Matchmaking
rules.body: Per server. Opponent names and power are visible; their gear isn't.

rules.title: Tickets
rules.body: One Arena ticket every 2 h; a free opponent refresh every 30 min.

rules.title: Seasons
rules.body: About two weeks each, closing 12:00 KST. Season 5 still live on 10-06.

rules.title: Tiers
rules.body: Champion 1–3 go to ranks 1–3. Master 4 to Grand Master 1 promote by absolute rank.

rules.title: Points
rules.body: An attack win pays +15 to +25. A failed defense costs 1–5.

rules.title: Revenge
rules.body: Revenge attacks from the defense log recoup more than the loss.

rules.title: Rewards
rules.body: Wins pay Fame (Boss, Element, Crit DMG levels) and Victory Medals.

rules.title: Promotion rewards
rules.body: First promotions pay diamonds: 4,000 for Elite Master 1 and Grand Master 3, 6,000 for Grand Master 2.

rules.title: Stats that count
rules.body: Level, promotion, codex, gear, plate, sugar runes and pet ownership effects (in-game help).

rules.title: Stats that don't
rules.body: Breakthrough, Stellar Link and the labs don't count, so displayed power overstates PvP strength.

rules.title: Merc perks
rules.body: Disputed: the in-game help omits them. The 10-08 patch adds help text on how they apply.

rules.title: Level cap
rules.body: Level counts, so the 10-08 cap raise to Lv.120 lifts Arena power.

rules.title: Power bracket
rules.body: The PvE power bracket is fixed at 100% in PvP.

rules.title: Season buffs
rules.body: No season passive in regular Arena. Season 1 skipped the defense's DR; fixed from Season 2.

rumble_arena.lede: Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나, 와레나): the cross-server arena. The top 100 still run one 12-cookie Oven–Bari team.
rumble_arena.caveat: Season 1's last day. Above 2,000 points levels and some defenders are hidden, so usage counts are lower bounds.

rules.title: Format
rules.body: The same auto-battle as Arena, run beside it, in one cross-server pool.

rules.title: Presets
rules.body: Its own 5 presets for attack and defense. Levels can't be changed there.

rules.title: Team size
rules.body: Up to 12 cookies and 3 pets. Empty slots are legal.

rules.title: Battle length
rules.body: About 60 s with a visible countdown.

rules.title: Season 1
rules.body: 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-08, battles closing 12:00 KST.

rules.title: Season 2
rules.body: Opens with the 10-08 update. Client data: 10-08 14:00 to 10-21 12:00 KST.

rules.title: Season 1 buff
rules.body: Charge cookies +30% max HP; all cookies and summons +30% DR. Both teams.

rules.title: Season buffs rotate
rules.body: Each season has its own passive. Season 2's was unannounced on 10-07.

rules.title: Tickets
rules.body: 5 free a day, refilled at 00:00; extras cost 1,000 mileage each.

rules.title: Points
rules.body: The win value shows before the fight. A held defense gives +1 or +2; a lost one −1 to −5.

rules.title: Promotion gems
rules.body: First promotions pay gems: out of Diamond 2 1,200, out of Master 2 1,800, into Elite Master 5 2,000, into Grand Master 3 4,000.

rules.title: Medals
rules.body: +175 medals per win or held defense at Master and Elite Master, up from +125.

rules.title: Anonymous opponents
rules.body: Above 2,000 points opponents show as 익명의 도전자, with power and levels as ???.

rules.title: Hidden defenders
rules.body: Above 2,000 points 2–3 of the 12 defenders show as hidden placeholders on attack screens. Defense logs show all 12.

rules.title: Revenge
rules.body: Revenge screens show 25–39 points; one player says a revenge paid only +3.

rules.title: Shop reset
rules.body: Disputed: posters say the Rumble shop resets every two weeks, monthly, or not at all.

rules.title: Leagues
rules.body: Platinum, Diamond, Master 5–1, Elite Master 5–1, Grand Master 3–1, Champion 3–1.

rules.title: Top leagues
rules.body: Grand Master 3/2/1 need 3,000 points and top 100/30/10; Champion 3/2/1 need 3,200 and top 3/2/1.

rules.title: Reward cliff
rules.body: Ranks ~101 to ~2,300 sat in Elite Master 1 on 10-07, all on the same reward.

rules.title: Daily rewards
rules.body: Daily mail: 2,500 medals to the top 100, 2,000 to Master top 5–30%.

rules.title: Shop
rules.body: Medals buy dungeon keys, chocolate, syrup, Stella rune rewards and a random box.

rules.title: Stats that count
rules.body: Players say stars and gear count, breakthrough and labs don't. No official text.
